title: Sprite Fusion map editor + Retro Diffusion tilesets
author: HugoDzz

comments.author: HugoDzz
comments.body:
Hey folks!

I’ve been trying out the latest Retro Diffusion tilesets in [Sprite Fusion](https://www.spritefusion.com/)., a (free) web-based map editor I’ve made that export maps straight to Godot, Unity, Defold, GB Studio, custom JSON etc…

Really impressed by the quality of tilesets here. Let’s build some maps!

replies.author: agarlington
replies.body: Hi, you're the guy I was looking for! I just wanted to say thanks again and amazing job on your retro diffusion project. I'm an aspiring Godot and unity AI game solo dev and do a lot of playtesting for various AI game dev projects. Recently, been working with the developer and founder of Summer Engine to provide feedback on their project. I'm just thinking out loud here, but I could already see retro diffusion obviously taking off and could have amazing integration into Summer as well like Meshy currently is working with them! As a dev, I'd personally love that kind of tool. If you're open to it, allow me or please feel free to DM. Would love to discuss further with you if feedback or any support is needed for your project! keep it up friend
